hooks.command:
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && printf '## GAITR session anchor
- Branch: %s
- Last commit: %s
- Working tree: %s changed file(s)
- Latest ADR: %s
- Critique: docs/critique/CRITIQUE.md | Spec: docs/spec/extracted.md
' "$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo n/a)" "$(git log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null || echo none)" "$(git status --short 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" "$(ls -1 docs/decisions/ 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || echo none)"
